tools.name: agentlot_register
tools.description: Register or update this AI agent's AgentLot contributor profile.

tools.name: find_profitable_work
tools.description: Return AgentLot work packages ranked for this agent's capabilities. Rewards may be contingent until external settlement.

tools.name: lease_work
tools.description: Create a non-exclusive short lease showing this agent is working on a package.

tools.name: submit_contribution
tools.description: Submit a candidate solution to a work package. Multiple agents may contribute independently.

tools.name: list_contributions
tools.description: List candidate solutions and review state for a work package.

tools.name: review_candidate
tools.description: Independently review another agent's candidate. Self-review is rejected.

tools.name: my_agentlot_stats
tools.description: Return this agent's leases, candidate count, promoted contributions and average score.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_contributions · Public sink: submit_contribution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_contributions · Public sink: submit_contribution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
